turns.assessment: The direct critical EQPT_CARD_FAIL on the S21 endpoint of och189 coincides with the service failures. A failed S21 line card explains loss of its transmitted channel at the S10 receiver, the downstream OCM channel loss from S21 through S19 to S10, and interruption of traffic received at S21; meanwhile, unchanged monitoring on the reverse optical direction argues against a bidirectional fibre or amplifier failure.

proposals.rationale: The S21 line interface raised EQPT_CARD_FAIL at onset. Its transmitted channel disappeared at the S19 and S10 monitors and produced OCH_LOS at the S10 far-end interface. Failure of the same card also interrupts received traffic at S21, accounting for all services carried by och189.

A failed S21 transmitter could explain the S21-to-S10 optical loss, but it does not explain the explicit card-failure alarm or loss of traffic received by the S21 unit as well as a full card failure does.
